specs.title: Decentralized Trust Graph — Zero-Knowledge Proof Specification
specs.description: The zero-knowledge layer of the Decentralized Trust Graph as construction records: for each proof the trust graph needs, what a verifier learns, from whom, without what — witness, public inputs, method clauses bound to gadgets, disclosure set, negative space, adversary, horizon, conformance fixtures, construction options across proving systems, issuance requirements — generated from machine-checked records with a stated evidence state.
specs.author: Trust over IP Foundation — DTG ZKP Task Force (working draft, evidence repository edition)
